senses.definition_en: With reference to past events; throughout history or in the past.
senses.definition_ar: تاريخياً، بالرجوع إلى أحداث الماضي أو على مر التاريخ.
examples: The region has historically been a center of trade.
Interest rates are at a historically low level.
